column1: # XOS Windows default registry values, applied at the end of Uninstall XOS
# Measured on clean Windows installs, builds 17763 to 28000, 2026-09-25
# Columns: key, value name, kind (dword, sz, delete), data, builds (* or a comma list of build numbers that ship the value)
# A delete row removes a value XOS writes that clean Windows does not have. A row whose builds exclude the running build is skipped.
# HKDU rows are the Default user profile hive (C:\Users\Default\NTUSER.DAT), loaded by the uninstall; the playbook writes the same values there for new accounts.
